definitions.gloss: different thing entirely, something completely different
definitions.explanation: Something that is fundamentally different from what it is being compared to. Emphasizes that two things that might appear similar are in fact not comparable.

examples.english: That and this are completely different things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{高級|こうきゅう}{店|てん}→高級店：29216_koukyuuten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別物|べつもの}だ。
examples.english: Cheap sushi and sushi from a high-end restaurant are entirely different things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{本番|ほんばん}→本番：19392_honban⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧まったく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{別物|べつもの}だ⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{痛感|つうかん}→痛感：13614_tsuukan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I keenly felt that practice and the real thing are completely different.

notes:
{別物|べつもの} emphasizes that two things that might appear similar are fundamentally different and not comparable.

FORMS:
⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (separate, different) + ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- まったく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{別物|べつもの}: a completely different thing (very common emphatic form)
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別物|べつもの}だ: is a different thing from ~
- {別物|べつもの}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧: to consider as something separate
- A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別物|べつもの}だ: A and B are entirely different things

USAGE:
Used to draw a sharp distinction between two things that might superficially seem alike. Often appears in debates, comparisons, and clarifications.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧: another/separate thing (neutral, not emphatic)
- ⟦{別格|べっかく}→別格：16015_bekkaku⟧: in a class of its own (emphasizes superiority)
